feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 14 September 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

S or SW 2 to 4, soon increasing 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the evening, veering W or SW 4 or 5 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of sea)##

Mainly slight, becoming mainly moderate in the evening.


##Weather)##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, then rain in the evening, heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Very poor in fog patches. Becoming mainly good later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
